invariants.description: Native build downloads and extraction fail closed.
First-party scripts reject missing tools and recover safely.
Resolved dependencies are pinned and vulnerability policy is explicit.
Repository validators preserve branch-aware and property-tested behavior.
Critical Kotlin modules preserve coverage floors and reviewed ABI dumps.

gates.remediation: Inspect buildSrc test and static-analysis reports; repair the same branch and rerun the build-logic gate.
Run the pinned ShellCheck, shfmt, and Bats commands and repair the failing script or fixture.
Review verification metadata, lockfiles, and the pinned OSV policy; never weaken an exception to pass.
Repair the validator/property test or its branch-coverage floor and rerun the Python gate.
Review the critical-module coverage floor or ABI diff; update baselines only for an intentional API change.
